messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

In line with your letter, we offer the firm, long-term commitment you prioritise. The attached packages give you full-year planning security for your capacity: 23400 pieces per year over 24 or 36 months. What is the earliest lead time you can confirm on these terms?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for the full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

We note your cost estimates and the proposed volume of 23,400 units over 24 months. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our capacity utilisation necessitates a lead time of 56 days. 

For a contract term of 24 months and a volume of 23400 pcs per year, we propose a price of €31.50 per unit. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 - firm 24-month commitment, revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

To answer your question: we commit to 23400 pieces per year over 24 months, firm. This is the long-term commitment your letter of 18 September says you prioritise, and it gives your capacity planning full-year security.

We have moved toward you in the attached packages. Our lead package keeps your 56-day lead time. The alternative package covers 42 days, our need date, if your capacity allows it.

Which earliest lead time could you confirm with this volume?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 - firm 24-month commitment, revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your firm commitment to 23400 units over 24 months. Regarding your question, our earliest confirmed lead time for this volume remains 56 days due to our capacity utilisation. 

In response to your revised offer, we propose a price of €31.30 per unit for these terms. For this volume of 23400 pcs per year over a contract term of 24 months, our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
